sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Zymosan recognition (ligand binding/phagocytosis readout) was fully preserved with the C-terminal HA-tagged construct (L2). Surface expression was confirmed by flow cytometry/immunofluorescence in macrophages (L3, L4) and in HEK293/RAW264.7 for the V5-tagged version (L6).
sites.rationale: CLEC7A is a type II single-pass transmembrane protein whose C-terminus (residue 247, M) is extracellular, 182 residues from the TM boundary (residue 65), satisfying the ≥3-residue clearance requirement with wide margin. The topology leaves exactly one extracellular terminus, so the C-terminal tag position is topology-derived from the landmarks. L1 explicitly states the HA tag was placed at the 3′/C-terminal end of the full-length membrane-anchored cDNA; L2 confirms zymosan recognition is unaffected; L3/L4 confirm surface display. L5/L6 independently corroborate the same junction with a V5-HIS tag. Python verification confirms seq[246]='M' (residue 247) and seq[245]='S' (residue 246). Full-length human Dectin-1 (CLEC7A) with HA tag appended to the C-terminus by PCR modification of the 3′ end of the cDNA; construct stably transduced into macrophages and expressed at the cell surface (L1, L3, L4). An independent construct with V5-HIS at the same C-terminal position was expressed at the cell surface in HEK293 and RAW264.7 cells (L5, L6).

sources.claim: Hemagglutinin (HA)-tagged Dectin-1 was generated by modifying the 3′ end of Dectin-1 cDNA ( 7 , 11 ) by PCR to allow the cloning of an adaptor, encoding an HA tag and a stop codon.

literature_notes: L5/L6 (V5-HIS C-terminal tag) pin the identical junction as L1 and are not a separate site. L8/L9/L10/L11 report C-terminal FLAG on murine Dectin-1 isoforms a and b, providing indirect ortholog corroboration of the same C-terminal extracellular junction; they are not listed as a separate site because L1 already provides direct human evidence at the same position. The N-terminal HA tags in L8–L11 and the N-terminal GFP fusion in L7 are intracellular and recorded in other_positions. No ledger line reports any internal loop insertion for CLEC7A.

literature_other_positions.note: eGFP fused to the N-terminus of full-length Dectin-1 (dectin-1 coding region fused to 3′ end of eGFP); the N-terminus of CLEC7A is intracellular (residues 1–44), so this GFP fusion is on the cytoplasmic face, not the cell surface.

N-terminal HA tag in HA-mDectin-1b-FLAG and HA-mDectin-1a-FLAG constructs (L8–L11); the N-terminus of Dectin-1 is intracellular, so this HA tag faces the cytoplasm and is not an extracellular surface tag.
